name: guard_then_dispatch_pointer
description: Compares register A4 with a stored value and, if they differ, calls through a pointer held at a negative offset from register A5. Otherwise it may make a call and then calls through the same pointer. The jump table could not be recovered.

name: call_then_dispatch_pointer
description: Makes an optional call when the input in register D1 is nonzero, then calls through a pointer stored at a negative offset from register A5. The jump table could not be recovered, so the target is unknown.

name: copy_string_to_buffer
description: Copies a null-terminated string into a newly allocated buffer with its length as a prefix byte, but only when the first byte is greater than thirty-two. It then allocates a structure through the exec library, fills in fields from a library table and links it into a list; the text reference names the dos library.

name: stub_return_minus_one

name: open_library_and_set_vector
description: Opens a library through the exec library, installs a replacement function entry with the exec set-function call, and then calls another routine. It returns the two result registers unchanged; the text reference names the dos library.

name: filter_status_codes
description: Calls a library function through a pointer stored in a global and compares the result against four specific codes. If the result matches one of them it returns the original input instead; otherwise it returns the result.

description: Returns the first value passed on the stack without any other work.

name: patch_vector_on_marker
description: Checks a byte in a table entry chosen by a register and, when it equals the letter d, saves the existing longword, writes a replacement routine address into that slot and sets three global words before calling through a stored pointer. Otherwise it returns immediately.

name: empty_return_routine
description: Returns immediately with no work.

name: forward_direct_call
description: Calls one other routine and then returns. It is a thin forwarding wrapper with no additional work.

name: classify_lookup_result_init
description: Calls a lookup routine and compares its result with five constant values to choose a number from one to four. It then either sets up the initial state and returns, or takes a fallback path that ends in an endless loop; it also clears a large block of memory.

name: update_bit_flags_in_memory
description: Sets and clears individual bits in several memory bytes and words, using bit positions computed from register values and mixing in constant masks. The decoded instructions look partly mangled, so the exact effect is only partly recoverable.

name: clear_bit_flag_in_memory
description: Clears one bit in a memory byte and applies masks to two words, then returns a value built from register inputs. Parts of the decoded instructions look garbled, so the exact effect is partly uncertain.

name: update_bit_flags_at_offset
description: Sets one bit in a byte at a fixed offset from a base register, clears another bit, and masks a longword before returning. The decoded instructions are partly garbled.

name: conditional_call_through_pointer
description: If the input value is nonzero it calls a routine through a function pointer stored in a global slot; otherwise it does nothing. It returns the two input registers unchanged.

name: empty_return_routine
description: Returns immediately with no work.

name: dispatch_by_mode_value
description: Stores a minus-one marker in a global and then branches on a stored mode number. Mode one clears a block of memory and resets state words, mode three calls a routine and negates its result when a flag is set, and other values only make one indirect call.

name: forward_direct_call
description: Calls one other routine and then returns. It is a thin forwarding wrapper with no additional work.

name: call_then_return_constant
description: Calls one other routine and then returns a fixed constant in the result register.

name: call_pointer_return_constant
description: Calls a routine through a function pointer kept in a global slot and returns a fixed constant. The referenced text is the file name prince.high.

name: call_twice_if_flag_clear
description: When a global word equals zero it calls the same pointer slot twice, then returns a fixed constant. The referenced text is the file name prince.high.

name: spin_forever_loop
description: Does nothing except loop endlessly; the decompiled body has no other work. The metadata lists the vertical beam position register, but the code shown does not read it.

name: return_concatenated_input_values
description: Calls a routine through a function pointer kept in a global slot, then returns the two input values concatenated as one result.

name: forward_direct_call
description: Calls one other routine and then returns. It is a thin forwarding wrapper with no additional work.

name: forward_direct_call
description: Calls one other routine and then returns. It is a thin forwarding wrapper with no additional work.

name: load_game_data_checked
description: Loads game data through a sequence of helper calls, clears a block of memory and sets starting state when a status check passes, and otherwise ends in an endless loop. The referenced text includes a load-failed retry message and the 1MEG and 512K version labels.

name: disable_audio_and_interrupts
description: Writes zero to the four audio volume registers and clears interrupt enable and request bits with masks that disable everything, then calls a reset routine and calls the routine stored in a global slot.

name: reset_then_call_entry
description: Calls a reset routine and then calls the routine stored at a global slot.

name: empty_return_routine
description: Returns immediately with no work.

name: reset_custom_chip_registers
description: Waits until a status bit is set, then writes a long run of zero and default values to audio, blitter, bitplane and DMA control registers. Writes with bit fifteen set enable the DMA channels they name.

name: initialise_cia_chips
description: Writes configuration values to the control, port direction and timer registers of both CIA chips and returns. Port A carries the joystick and mouse fire buttons and the disk status lines.

name: fill_vector_table_with_handler
description: Walks a table of longwords in low memory and writes a handler address into each slot except one special slot, stopping at the end of the first two hundred fifty-six bytes.

name: report_unexpected_load_error
description: Calls two routines and then loops forever. The referenced text is an unexpected load exception message, so this is a fatal error exit.

name: delay_using_cia_timer
description: Waits on a CIA status flag, then splits the input count into chunks of at most ninety and loads the timer with each chunk scaled by a fixed multiplier, waiting between loads.

name: load_scaled_cia_timer
description: Waits until a CIA control flag is clear, scales the input by a fixed multiplier with rounding, and writes the high bytes to the timer if they are nonzero. It returns the original input.

name: poll_disk_ready_line
description: Writes disk-control values to a CIA port and to the audio-disk control register, then reads the disk status line and, if a status bit is set, polls another status bit in a loop. Returns the register pair unchanged.

name: pulse_disk_select_line
description: Drives a CIA port line low, waits for a status line to clear, then drives the port high again.

name: forward_direct_call
description: Calls one other routine and then returns. It is a thin forwarding wrapper with no additional work.

name: repeat_until_status_one
description: Calls a helper in a loop while its returned value stays negative, stopping early when the status value equals one.

name: search_sector_sync_marker
description: Checks disk status bits, then scans up to four candidate positions for a fixed two-word sync pattern followed by a matching value, and records a comparison result. Nothing happens unless the status bits show the drive is ready.

name: repeat_until_status_one
description: Calls a helper in a loop while its returned value stays negative, stopping early when the status value equals one.

name: return_stack_argument
description: Returns the first value passed on the stack without any other work.

name: return_stack_argument
description: Returns the first value passed on the stack without any other work.

name: retry_disk_step_four_times
description: When the disk status bits show a ready drive, runs up to four attempts, each calling helpers and checking a stored value's sign, and stops early when that value goes negative.

name: return_stack_argument
description: Returns the first value passed on the stack without any other work.

name: fill_track_buffer_with_sync
description: Fills a buffer of about three hundred seventy-two words with an alternating bit pattern, then writes a sync marker and a header and calls helpers to finish.

name: wait_for_disk_idle
description: Waits while a status bit is set, then sets a control bit in a CIA port and clears a stored counter to zero.

name: step_disk_head_to_track
description: Sets or clears a direction bit according to the lowest bit of the input, then compares the new position with the stored one and calls a helper repeatedly to step the head toward it.

name: set_disk_control_bits_one
description: Clears the two low control bits of a CIA port, sets the lowest bit and calls a helper.

name: set_disk_control_bits_three
description: Sets the two low control bits of a CIA port to one and calls a helper.

name: start_disk_dma_transfer
description: Writes a DMA pointer and length, waits for a request bit, then programs the sync word and DMA control registers to start a transfer.

name: start_disk_dma_with_helper
description: Waits for a request bit, writes DMA control and length values, stores a pointer and calls a helper.

name: unpack_interleaved_bit_pairs
description: Splits each 16-bit word of an input block into two outputs, each holding alternating bit positions from the source word. It is the usual unpacking step for interleaved disk data.

name: encode_bit_pairs_in_place
description: Walks a block of words, combining each masked word with the bit carried from the previous one, and rewrites the block in place.

name: interleave_bit_fields
description: Merges two masked input streams into one output by shifting the bits of the first into the upper positions and OR-ing in the second, word by word.

name: combine_masked_long_halves
description: Reads two longwords, masks alternating bits of the first and shifts it left, ORs in the masked second, and returns the pair.

name: compute_xor_checksum_longwords
description: XORs every longword in a block together, using a count derived from the input length, and returns the combined result with alternating bits masked.

name: call_two_helpers_then_return
description: Calls two helper routines in sequence and returns.

name: loop_calling_helpers_until_flag
description: Calls helper routines in a loop until a negative flag is set, then calls one final helper and returns.

name: call_then_return_stack_argument
description: Calls a helper and then returns the value passed on the stack. Among its callees is a routine that writes a constant byte to a global variable.

name: setup_display_registers
description: Writes display window, data fetch, bitplane modulo, colour and copper list registers, enables display DMA, and returns. It sets the background colour and points the copper at a list.
